set-variable.name: mcp-tool-name
set-variable.value: @{ var segments = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path.Trim('/').Split('/'); return segments.Length >= 3 && string.Equals(segments[1], "tools", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? segments[2] : string.Empty; }

set-variable.name: selected-tool
set-variable.value: @{ var toolName = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcp-tool-name", string.Empty); var catalog = JArray.Parse((string)context.Variables["mcp-route-catalog"]); var selected = catalog.Children<JObject>().FirstOrDefault(entry => string.Equals((string)entry["name"], toolName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)); return selected == null ? string.Empty : selected.ToString(); }

return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", "ToolNotFound"), new JProperty("message", "The requested MCP tool is not registered in APIM."), new JProperty("tool", (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcp-tool-name", string.Empty))))).ToString(); }

set-backend-service.base-url: @{ var catalog = JArray.Parse((string)context.Variables["mcp-route-catalog"]); var selected = catalog.Children<JObject>().FirstOrDefault(); return selected == null ? string.Empty : (string)selected["backendUrl"]; }

inbound.log-to-application-insights: @{ return new { eventType = "mcp-request", path = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path, tool = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcp-tool-name", string.Empty), correlationId = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("correlation-id", context.RequestId.ToString()) }; }

outbound.log-to-application-insights: @{ return new { eventType = "mcp-response", path = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path, statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode, tool = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcp-tool-name", string.Empty) }; }

return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", context.LastError != null ? context.LastError.Reason : "McpGatewayError"), new JProperty("message", context.LastError != null ? context.LastError.Message : "The MCP gateway request failed."), new JProperty("correlationId", (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("correlation-id", context.RequestId.ToString()))))).ToString(); }
